headline: TORM Reports Strong Third-Quarter Results on Product Tanker Demand
summary: TORM plc reported strong third-quarter results driven by favorable market conditions and healthy transportation demand. Chief Executive Officer Jacob Meldgaard cited confidence in the long-term outlook for the product tanker market.
why: TORM plc is a major Denmark-headquartered shipping company specializing in the transportation of refined oil products globally.

impacts.name: TORM plc
impacts.why: TORM plc announced its third-quarter financial results and dividend distribution.
